notes:
YLLW 0.5.8
- Many more phones: 52 in all, grouped by brand. New are the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max and iPhone 17, Galaxy S26 and S25 lines, A57 and A37, Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8 (inside and cover screens), Pixel 11, 10 and 9 lines and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Nothing Phone (3), (4a) Pro and (4) Base, CMF Phone 2 Pro, OnePlus 15 and 13, Xperia 1 VIII, Xiaomi 17 Ultra and 17T Pro, and Razr+ 2026 and Razr Ultra 2025.
- Each phone frame is drawn from its maker's measurements where they're published, with its own corner shape, camera cutout (Dynamic Island, notch, punch-hole or cover-screen cameras), button placement and colors. Foldables show a crease.
- A status bar (time, signal, battery) and home bar now take the space they take on a real phone, so the page gets the height a real visitor gets. Turn them off in Devices or from Ctrl+K.
- In One at a time layout, the floating bar has a device menu that switches the pane you're looking at to any phone, tablet or computer.
- The Devices list is grouped by brand with a filter, and shows each screen's pixel ratio. New layouts: Android phones and Foldables.
- The tour covers the device list and the status bar.
